description: This file contains implementation of sharding propagation mechanisms for distributed tensor operations in PyTorch. It defines classes and functions to register and execute strategies for propagating sharding metadata through various tensor operations, supporting features like caching, cost-based strategy selection, and rule-based propagation. It is specific to distributed tensor sharding logic within the PyTorch distributed framework.
